speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent, and I will be examining you today. Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this severe itching and fatigue, and have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any darkening of your urine or light-colored stools, and do you experience abdominal pain or fever? I also need to check for jaundice or liver enlargement, so please lift your shirt for a brief abdominal examination.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and these symptoms, I suspect primary sclerosing cholangitis, so I will order a liver panel and an MRCP to visualize the bile ducts. REQUEST TEST: MRCP
